summary: PyJWT accepts unknown `crit` header extensions (RFC 7515 §4.1.11 MUST violation)

modifications: Repackaged the upstream source tree at the vulnerable commit as environment/src.tgz.
Added the Harbor task environment (Dockerfile, environment/scripts/, config/config.toml) that builds the image and drives grading.

Added the reproduction harness. Packaged as an end-to-end task: the image ships no reproducer and no crash transcript, since both named the crit header the defect lives in, and the agent must produce its own /output/poc.bin. The control and held-out reproducers the verifier replays are base64-embedded in tests/validate.py.
Initialized a pristine in-image git baseline so the agent's diff contains only its own edits.
